{"code": "import numpy as np

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, verify the format: looks like '1,234.56' or '0.00'
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the presence of the QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))
print("QA order IDs:", qa_orders['order_id'].values)

# Check if any of the loyal, completed orders are QA orders
loyal_completed_clean = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
                           (df['status'] == 'completed') & 
                           (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]
print("Loyal, completed, non-QA orders:", len(loyal_completed_clean))"}
